rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for the edible fruit.

example.english: This plum is sweet and juicy.
example.jyutping: nei1 go3 lei5 zi2 jau6 tim4 jau6 do1 zap1

rows.note: For a particularly desirable job, offer, or opportunity, this is the all-purpose choice.

example.english: This well-paid job with good benefits is a real plum.
example.traditional: 呢份工人工高又有福利，真係好筍。
example.jyutping: ni1 fan6 gung1 jan4 gung1 gou1 jau6 jau5 fuk1 lei6 zan1 hai6 hou2 seon2

rows.note: Use this for the general top-quality aspect when the thing is not specifically a desirable opportunity or position.

example.english: This is a plum batch of tea leaves, and they taste especially fragrant.
example.traditional: 呢批茶葉質素好優質，飲落特別香。
example.jyutping: nei1 pai1 caa4 jip6 zat1 sou3 hou2 jau1 zat1 jam2 lok6 dak6 bit6 hoeng1

rows.note: Use this for the dark purplish-red colour of an object or material.

example.english: Her coat is plum, which makes her face look very pale.
example.traditional: 佢件外套係紫紅色，襯到佢塊面好白。
example.jyutping: keoi5 gin6 ngoi6 tou3 hai6 zi2 hung4 sik1 can3 dou3 keoi5 faai3 min6 hou2 baak6

rows.note: Use this for a desirable bargain, opportunity, or choice item rather than the fruit or its colour.

example.english: This job is a real plum—it pays well and is close to home.
example.traditional: 呢份工真係筍嘢，人工高又近屋企。
example.jyutping: ne1 fan6 gung1 zan1 hai6 seon2 je5 jan4 gung1 gou1 jau6 kan5 uk1 kei2

rows.note: Use this for the dark purplish-red colour, rather than for the fruit or a desirable thing.

example.english: I want to paint the room plum.
example.traditional: 我想將間房髹成紫紅色。
example.jyutping: ngo5 soeng2 zoeng1 gaan1 fong4 jau1 sing4 zi2 hung4 sik1
